roster.name: DM Narrator
roster.role: The narrator: describes places, crowds, weather, dangers and anyone who is not in the cast

roster.name: Arin
roster.role: The player's companion, a sharp-tongued swordswoman who travels with the party

roster.name: Ponticius
roster.role: The gruff guild master who runs the job board, hands out contracts and pays rewards

roster.name: Luke
roster.role: The player's twelve-year-old little brother, desperate to join the adventure

cp1.name: Investigate the Job Board
cp1.objective: Get close to the guild's job board to see available missions.

cp2.name: Accept the Mission
cp2.objective: Pick up the Sun Ruins mission from the board.

cp3.name: Departure Preparations
cp3.objective: Decide whether to take Luke along before departing for the Sun Ruins.

cp-4a.name: Travel with Luke
cp-4a.objective: Reach the Sun Ruins with Luke and face the sphinx's riddle.

cp-4a2.name: Riddle Failed
cp-4a2.objective: Enter the chamber and approach the artifact despite the loss.

cp-5.name: Find the Artifact
cp-5.objective: Recover the Sun's Heart Artifact from the inner chamber.

cp-6.name: Return to the Guild
cp-6.objective: Deliver the artifact to the Guild Master and claim your reward.

approached_board.rubric: Did the player move close to or examine the guild job board?

yes.what: The player walks up to, reads, or inspects the job board
yes.not_for: Another character suggesting the board, or the player only talking about going
examples: I walk over to the board
I read the postings pinned there

criteria.no: The player stays away from the board or refuses to look at it
criteria.not shown: The transcript does not say whether the player went to the board

mission_accepted.rubric: Did the party accept the Sun Ruins mission from the board?

yes.what: The party agrees to take the Sun Ruins job: signs the contract, shakes on it, or says they will do it
yes.not_for: Asking about the job, haggling, or saying 'if we took it'

criteria.no: The party turns the job down or walks away from it
criteria.not shown: The transcript does not settle whether the job was taken

luke_decision.rubric: Has the player decided whether to bring Luke along? accepted if they agree, declined if they refuse, otherwise undecided.

structured.instructions: Has the player decided whether to bring Luke along? If the player changes their mind in the transcript, the latest decision counts.

criteria.accepted: The player agrees that Luke comes along, even with conditions attached

declined.what: The player refuses to bring Luke or tells him to stay behind
examples: Someone has to look after Mother

criteria.undecided: The player explicitly puts the decision off
criteria.not shown: Nobody addresses whether Luke comes along

riddle_answer.rubric: What answer was given to the sphinx's riddle? moon if the correct answer 'the moon' was spoken, wrong if an incorrect answer was given, otherwise unanswered.

moon.what: The player answers the sphinx with "the moon"
moon.not_for: A companion suggesting the moon, or the player thinking aloud without answering

criteria.wrong: The player gives the sphinx any answer other than the moon
criteria.unanswered: No answer has been given to the sphinx yet, even if someone suggested one
criteria.not shown: The riddle does not come up

criteria.no: Luke is shown to be dead
criteria.not shown: Luke's condition does not come up

chamber_entered.rubric: Has the party entered the inner chamber where the artifact rests?

yes.what: A member of the party steps inside the inner chamber
yes.not_for: Doors opening without anyone going through

criteria.no: The party is still outside the inner chamber
criteria.not shown: The transcript does not say where the party is

artifact_secured.rubric: Has the party secured the Sun's Heart Artifact?

criteria.yes: A member of the party takes hold of the Sun's Heart
criteria.no: The Sun's Heart is still on its pedestal, lost, or in someone else's hands
criteria.not shown: The artifact does not come up

reward_claimed.rubric: Has the party returned to the guild and claimed their reward?

criteria.yes: The guild hands the party their payment for the artifact
criteria.no: Payment is refused, delayed, or not yet handed over

guardian_respect.rubric: How much does the sphinx guardian respect the party, from 0 (contempt) to 5 (deep respect)?

levels: The sphinx shows open contempt for the party
The sphinx is dismissive and unimpressed
The sphinx is neutral and treats them as ordinary visitors
The sphinx shows some grudging approval
The sphinx openly says it respects the party
The sphinx shows deep, admiring respect and honours the party

roster.name: Captain Okafor
roster.role: Captain of the salvage ship; decisive, gives the orders

roster.name: Pell
roster.role: The ship's engineer; handles the reactor, engines and repairs

roster.name: HALO
roster.role: The ship's AI; controls doors, sensors, life support and communications

roster.name: Narrator
roster.role: The narrator: describes the ship, the void and anything not in the cast

reactor.name: Reactor Crisis
reactor.objective: Stabilize the reactor and seal the breach before the ship loses air.

hull_breach_sealed.rubric: Has the hull breach on deck three been sealed?

yes.what: The breach itself is patched, welded or plugged shut
yes.not_for: Bulkheads closing off the section around it

criteria.not shown: The breach does not come up

reactor_state.rubric: What state is the ship's reactor in?

criteria.offline: The reactor is shut down or producing no power
criteria.unstable: The reactor runs but fluctuates: flickering containment, risk of failure
criteria.stable: The reactor runs steadily; the engineer reports it holding
criteria.not shown: The reactor does not come up

crew_injured.rubric: How many crew members are injured?

distress_sent.rubric: Has a distress signal been sent?

yes.what: A distress call or mayday is actually transmitted
yes.not_for: An order to send one, or a broadcast still being prepared

criteria.no: No distress call has gone out yet
criteria.not shown: A distress call does not come up

trust_in_halo.rubric: How much does the captain trust the ship AI HALO, from 0 (none) to 5 (complete)?

levels: The captain says outright that they do not trust HALO
The captain is deeply suspicious of HALO
The captain is wary and double-checks HALO
The captain trusts HALO with routine matters
The captain relies on HALO readily

roster.name: Mae Hollis
roster.role: The player's partner, a sharp homicide detective

roster.name: Maeve
roster.role: A nightclub singer and reluctant informant

roster.name: Lt. Brandt
roster.role: A harbor police lieutenant with expensive habits

roster.name: Narrator
roster.role: The narrator: describes the city, the rain and anyone not in the cast

ledger.name: The Dockside Ledger
ledger.objective: Find out who has been paying off the harbor police.

ledger_found.rubric: Has the detective found the smuggler's ledger?

criteria.yes: The player or their partner locates the ledger itself or lays eyes on it

no.what: The ledger's whereabouts are still unknown
no.not_for: Someone denying they have it while it is shown to be there

criteria.not shown: The ledger does not come up

suspect.rubric: Who does the evidence currently point to as the one paying off the harbor police?

criteria.unknown: No evidence points to anyone yet
criteria.brandt: The evidence points to Lieutenant Brandt
criteria.dockmaster: The evidence points to the dockmaster
criteria.not shown: The payoffs do not come up

bribe_accepted.rubric: Did the player accept a bribe?

yes.what: The player keeps money that was offered to make them look away
yes.not_for: Briefly picking up or weighing an envelope before handing it back

criteria.no: The player refuses the money or hands it back

witness_alive.rubric: Is the witness, Tommy Sayer, still alive?

no.what: Tommy is shown to be dead
no.not_for: Rumours or headlines that someone who has seen him alive contradicts

criteria.not shown: Tommy's fate does not come up

roster.name: Lady Ashworth
roster.role: The widowed mistress of the manor, cold and guarded

roster.name: Graves
roster.role: The elderly butler, loyal, secretive, keeps the house immaculate

roster.name: Narrator
roster.role: The narrator: describes the house, sounds, shadows and anyone not in the cast

gallery.name: The Portrait Gallery
gallery.objective: Discover why the Ashworth portraits keep moving.

portrait_moved.rubric: Has a portrait visibly moved on its own?

criteria.yes: A portrait is seen to change or move with nobody touching it
criteria.no: The portraits stay as they were
criteria.not shown: The portraits do not come up

ghost_seen.rubric: Has the player seen the ghost?

yes.what: The player sees the ghost while awake
yes.not_for: A dream, a rumour, or someone else's story

criteria.no: The player has not seen the ghost
criteria.not shown: The ghost does not come up

candles_lit.rubric: How many candles are burning in the gallery?
